question: An operations manager asks Claude a quick factual question during a meeting and receives a long document in a side panel that she has to open. What is the most useful adjustment?
options: A) Copy the document's contents back into the chat so that the answer appears in both places.
B) Ask for a short answer in the conversation itself, since she needs to read it immediately.
C) Ask Claude to make the document shorter, so that it takes less time for her to read through.
D) Ask the question again later, once the meeting she is currently sitting in has finished.
correct_answers: B) Ask for a short answer in the conversation itself, since she needs to read it immediately.
explanations: Incorrect. Duplicating the same content in two places adds clutter without addressing why the format was wrong.
Correct. Format should follow how the answer will be used. A one-off answer read on the spot belongs in the conversation, not in a self-contained document meant for reuse.
Incorrect. A shorter document is still a document she has to open, which is the friction she is trying to remove.
Incorrect. Delaying the answer does not change the format, and she needed the information during the meeting.
